exposure: mothers with MS vs MS-free mothers
cohort: 29,568 singleton births in Sweden between 2006 and 2020, including 3418 births to mothers with multiple sclerosis
finding: Maternal multiple sclerosis was associated with increased risks of elective caesarean sections, instrumental delivery, maternal infection, antepartum haemorrhage/placental abruption, medically indicated preterm birth, and small for gestational age, but DMT exposure was not associated with increased risks of malformations.
mod_finding: Compared with MS-free controls, maternal multiple sclerosis was associated with increased risks of elective caesarean sections and instrumental delivery.
